name: Justin Abrams
bio: Spent 15 years scaling local businesses across New England before starting the Boston Marketing Company. Believes great marketing should be measurable, honest, and built around real customer relationships — not vanity metrics.

name: Josh Eissler
bio: Manages 7-figures in annual ad spend across Google, Meta, TikTok, and LSAs. Cut his teeth running campaigns for one of Boston's largest auto groups — learned what high-stakes performance marketing actually looks like.

name: Vivian Sierra
bio: Built brand systems for local startups, restaurants, and SaaS companies before joining the team. Obsessed with consistency — believes the best logo work is invisible, and the best campaigns feel inevitable.

name: Shohel Das
bio: Engineering background turned SEO specialist. Built ranking systems that put Boston businesses on page one for the keywords that actually drive revenue. Loves data, has zero tolerance for fluff.
